system.description:
As an Action, you can begin to use your Nature Energy to siphon chakra from your foes. By spending 3 Nature Energy, all creatures you can see in a 15-foot cube, up to 30 feet away from you, must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they take 2d6 Chakra damage and gain the Sealed condition or half as much damage on a success. This increases to 4d6 at 7th level and 6d6 chakra damage at 15th level.

Beginning at 11th level, by choosing to instead spend 4 Nature Energy, you can use this ability as a Bonus action instead of an Action.
